name: BenchCAD
intro: BenchCAD 是工业程序化 CAD 推理基准，包含 106 个零件族的 17,900 个执行验证 CadQuery 程序。它以四个配套任务评估多视图到代码、视觉问答、代码问答和指令式代码编辑。
build_method: 领域专家零件族生成器, 工业标准与约束采样, 沙箱执行验证, 四视图人工复核
metric: Execution Rate, Voxel IoU, Chamfer, Hausdorff, Feature F1, QA Accuracy, Normalized Edit Improvement
eval_feature: 执行验证, 工业标准零件族, 几何与参数联合评测, 盲基线控制
scale: 17,900个程序, 106个零件族; 4,800条QA记录; 748个编辑对
build_method_en: Domain-expert family generators, industrial standards and constrained sampling, sandbox execution validation, four-view human review
eval_feature_en: Execution verification, industry-standard part families, joint geometry and parameter evaluation, blind controls
intro_en: BenchCAD is an industrial programmatic-CAD reasoning benchmark with 17,900 execution-verified CadQuery programs across 106 part families. Four matched tasks evaluate multi-view-to-code generation, visual QA, code QA, and instruction-guided code editing.
scale_en: 17,900 programs, 106 part families; 4,800 QA records; 748 edit pairs
metric_en: Execution Rate, Voxel IoU, Chamfer, Hausdorff, Feature F1, QA Accuracy, Normalized Edit Improvement

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2605.10865 and the official BenchCAD project. The diagram preserves expert-authored deterministic CadQuery family generators, 106 families, 52 standard-anchored families covering 47 industrial standards, constrained parameter sampling, sandbox rejection for parse/import/runtime/timeout/degenerate failures, four canonical renders and expert sign-off, and the code/STEP/views/parameters/operation-list artifact bundle. It separately traces the 17,900-program core, 2,400 QA pairs expanded to 4,800 VisionQA/CodeQA records, 748 verified CodeEdit pairs, four task protocols, geometry/feature/QA/edit metrics, and blind-control interpretation.
